race.description: Tradies Support The Ladies Pink Night At The Track Mdn Hcp
race.comment: LITTLE DUKE (1) has not raced since missing the kick and failing on debut at Quirindi in May. Firmed to start $2.80 favourite that day so a lot more was expected. Anticipating a better run to launch this prep against questionable opposition. FABULOUS ONE (4) settled midfield but couldn't go on with the job when resuming over this distance at Dubbo recently. That was his first appearance in 13 months so there is a stack of room for improvement. RIVANA (6) found a 900m maiden at Newcastle too taxing when fresh from an 11-month spell last start. Placed at four of seven over this trip and two from four when second-up. Likely improver. SUVATHI (11) can improve third-up after striking better maidens in her two runs this prep. Market watch on the five-year-old mare FIERY BEE (3) on debut on the back of a couple of quiet trials.
